amendment_before_results.reason: The repository already contains a measured fresh-baseline discrepancy from the earlier H51-K1 run: 0.28531515486970865 versus the frozen 0.285340602656319 (delta -0.0000254478; outside the previous 1e-5 harness tolerance), with folds 1-5 exact and a fold-0 emitter tie difference. This was known before any K2 feature implementation or score.
amendment_before_results.decision: Keep the discrepancy visible and report it. For K2, require its q10-gated score to exceed the historical frozen best and require a positive paired delta against the newly fit same-fold q10-gated H-D/H-H baseline with at least 4/6 folds positive. The known historical bit-reproduction failure is reported as a harness irregularity, not silently ignored; it is not a K2 promotion veto after the dual absolute-and-paired candidate comparisons are frozen here.

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.name: radiometric ratio boundary at an independent structure
seismicity ridge conditioned on an independent structure
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.official_availability: GDR submission 1391 lists a public 22.98 MB Earthquake Density Models ZIP; exact archive semantics have not been audited here.

k2_feature_operator.basement_edge_threshold: retain centres at or above q75 of the corresponding basement-gradient magnitude, estimated deterministically over finite footprint pixels without labels; valid off-edge cells receive zero signal
k2_feature_operator.cross_flank_halfwidth_pixels: 1.5 * sigma (3 px at sigma 2; 7.5 px at sigma 5)
channels_per_scale: average-tie empirical rank of median_j(abs(d_j)) among retained edge centres
k2_feature_operator.missing_data: mask-aware normalised Gaussian derivatives and bilinear samples; centre invalid if any of the 15 along/normal conductivity samples is outside valid support

stage1.goal: broad coarse-tile prior; no point placement
stage1.tile_area: actual count of common valid footprint pixels per tile times 100 m squared
stage1.segment_clipping: exact split at 100 m raster-cell boundaries, retaining only segment length inside common valid geodetic footprint pixels; tensor sum then clipped by tile
stage1.quantile_direction: approve scores at or above the 10th percentile; approximately 90% of eligible tiles
stage1.unknown_sense_policy: omit from tensor, report in-footprint segment count, unique record count and omitted length; do not assign N/RL/LL
stage1.residual_rule: for each of 4 rate-component/unit scenarios, convert observed source scalar dilation/shear to yr^-1, subtract tensor-derived source-definition-matched scalar dilation/shear, rank each signed residual on eligible common-support tiles, average dilation/shear ranks per scenario, average the 4 scenario scores
validation: five-repeat uniform-in-approved versus uniform-in-footprint visible-catalogue proxy DTI
limitations: scattered whole-trace rather than spatially independent holdout
QFault source field definition does not resolve fault-plane versus vertical slip-rate convention
source README unit notation 10E-9/yr is ambiguous
200-pixel tiles are coarse priors only, not fine geodetic inference
off-fault strain, aseismic creep, catalogue incompleteness and model error can all create positive residuals

stage2.spatial_folds: six truth-bearing blocks of the fixed 3x3 spatial grid
stage2.model: existing HistGradientBoosting pipeline: max_iter=250, learning_rate=0.08, max_leaf_nodes=63, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, max_bins=255, early_stopping=False
stage2.emitter: fixed STE L9, ridge scales [1.0, 2.0, 3.5], continuity weight 0.35, spacing 2.4 px
stage2.baseline: 0.5 * fresh H-D fold field + 0.5 * fresh H-H fold field
stage2.candidate: 0.5 * fresh H-D fold field + 0.5 * fresh (H-H plus the four K2 channels) fold field
stage2.stage1_domain: the spatial-fold-specific q10 mask computed after excluding every QFault record with any valid trace fragment intersecting the held-out block from the physical slip budget

local_format_checks: null/NaN only outside submission bounds, with compatibility not claimed absent portal validation

artifact_policy.if_candidate_fails: may write one freshly inferred diagnostic GeoTIFF only if labelled RESEARCH ONLY — DO NOT SUBMIT; do not use competition slot
artifact_policy.uniqueness_inventory_scope: all repository TIFFs, official public reference files obtainable through existing scripts, and checked sibling-project artifacts; state the scope and any unavailable set
artifact_policy.portal_range_guard: validate every serialized Float32 pixel is finite and assert minimum >= 0 and maximum <= 1; fail build otherwise
